having_state.label: -ing with state verbs (am having, am knowing)
having_state.en: Verbs like have (own), know, want and belong describe a state, so they don't take -ing. Say "I have", not "I am having".
having_state.roman: "Have, know, want, belong" jaise verbs haalat batate hain, is liye in ke saath -ing nahi lagta. "I am having" nahi, "I have" kahein.
having_state.urdu: ‏have، know، want، belong‏ جیسے افعال کسی حالت کو بیان کرتے ہیں، اس لیے ان کے ساتھ ‏-ing‏ نہیں لگتا۔ ‏"I am having"‏ نہیں، ‏"I have"‏ کہیں۔

experience_of.label: missing 'of' in 'X years of experience'
experience_of.en: Use "of" between the time and "experience": "3 years of experience".
experience_of.roman: Waqt aur "experience" ke beech "of" aata hai: "3 years of experience".
experience_of.urdu: وقت اور ‏"experience"‏ کے درمیان ‏"of"‏ آتا ہے: ‏"3 years of experience"‏۔

since_for.label: since vs for
since_for.en: Use "for" with a length of time (for two years) and "since" with a starting point (since 2022).
since_for.roman: Muddat ke saath "for" aata hai (for two years), aur shuru hone ke waqt ke saath "since" (since 2022).
since_for.urdu: مدت کے ساتھ ‏"for"‏ آتا ہے ‏(for two years)‏، اور شروع ہونے کے وقت کے ساتھ ‏"since"‏ ‏(since 2022)‏۔

present_perfect_continuous.label: present continuous instead of present perfect continuous
present_perfect_continuous.en: For something that started in the past and is still going on, use "have been + -ing": "I have been working here for two years".
present_perfect_continuous.roman: Jo kaam pehle shuru hua aur ab bhi chal raha hai, us ke liye "have been + -ing" lagta hai: "I have been working here for two years".
present_perfect_continuous.urdu: جو کام پہلے شروع ہوا اور اب بھی جاری ہے، اس کے لیے ‏"have been + -ing"‏ لگتا ہے: ‏"I have been working here for two years"‏۔

past_tense.label: present tense used for a past event
past_tense.en: Words like yesterday or last week need the past tense: go → went, complete → completed.
past_tense.roman: "Yesterday" ya "last week" jaise alfaaz ke saath past tense aata hai: go → went, complete → completed.
past_tense.urdu: ‏"yesterday"‏ یا ‏"last week"‏ جیسے الفاظ کے ساتھ ماضی کا صیغہ آتا ہے: ‏go → went، complete → completed‏۔

subject_verb_agreement.label: he/she/it with don't/have/go
subject_verb_agreement.en: With he, she or it, use doesn't / has / goes: "He doesn't know".
subject_verb_agreement.roman: He, she ya it ke saath doesn't / has / goes aata hai: "He doesn't know".
subject_verb_agreement.urdu: ‏he، she‏ یا ‏it‏ کے ساتھ ‏doesn't / has / goes‏ آتا ہے: ‏"He doesn't know"‏۔

discuss_about.label: discuss about / mention about
discuss_about.en: "Discuss" already includes "about": say "discuss the salary", not "discuss about the salary".
discuss_about.roman: "Discuss" ke andar "about" ka matlab pehle se hai: "discuss the salary" kahein, "discuss about" nahi.
discuss_about.urdu: ‏"discuss"‏ کے اندر ‏"about"‏ کا مطلب پہلے سے موجود ہے: ‏"discuss the salary"‏ کہیں، ‏"discuss about"‏ نہیں۔

can_able.label: can able to
can_able.en: Use either "can" or "am able to", never both: "I can handle pressure".
can_able.roman: Ya "can" kahein ya "am able to", dono ek saath nahi: "I can handle pressure".
can_able.urdu: یا ‏"can"‏ کہیں یا ‏"am able to"‏، دونوں ایک ساتھ نہیں: ‏"I can handle pressure"‏۔

myself_intro.label: 'Myself X' introduction
myself_intro.en: To introduce yourself, say "I'm Ali" or "My name is Ali", not "Myself Ali".
myself_intro.roman: Apna taaruf karwate waqt "I'm Ali" ya "My name is Ali" kahein, "Myself Ali" nahi.
myself_intro.urdu: اپنا تعارف کرواتے وقت ‏"I'm Ali"‏ یا ‏"My name is Ali"‏ کہیں، ‏"Myself Ali"‏ نہیں۔

belong_from.label: I am belonging from
belong_from.en: Say "I'm from Lahore". "Belong" means being part of something, and it never takes -ing.
belong_from.roman: "I'm from Lahore" kahein. "Belong" ka matlab kisi cheez ka hissa hona hai, aur is ke saath -ing nahi lagta.
belong_from.urdu: ‏"I'm from Lahore"‏ کہیں۔ ‏"belong"‏ کا مطلب کسی چیز کا حصہ ہونا ہے، اور اس کے ساتھ ‏-ing‏ نہیں لگتا۔

done_graduation.label: I have done my graduation
done_graduation.en: Say "I graduated from Punjab University in 2021". A finished year needs the simple past, not "have done".
done_graduation.roman: "I graduated from Punjab University in 2021" kahein. Guzra hua saal ho to simple past aata hai, "have done" nahi.
done_graduation.urdu: ‏"I graduated from Punjab University in 2021"‏ کہیں۔ گزرا ہوا سال ہو تو سادہ ماضی آتا ہے، ‏"have done"‏ نہیں۔

do_the_needful.label: do the needful / revert back
do_the_needful.en: "Do the needful" and "revert back" sound outdated. Say "Please take care of it and get back to me".
do_the_needful.roman: "Do the needful" aur "revert back" purane lagte hain. "Please take care of it and get back to me" kahein.
do_the_needful.urdu: ‏"do the needful"‏ اور ‏"revert back"‏ پرانے لگتے ہیں۔ ‏"Please take care of it and get back to me"‏ کہیں۔

article_missing.label: missing a/an/the
article_missing.en: Singular countable nouns need an article: "a hard worker", "the office".
article_missing.roman: Akeli ginne wali cheez ke saath a/an/the zaroori hai: "a hard worker", "the office".
article_missing.urdu: اکیلی گنی جانے والی چیز کے ساتھ ‏a/an/the‏ ضروری ہے: ‏"a hard worker"، "the office"‏۔

question_order.label: question word order
question_order.en: In a question the helper verb comes before the subject: "Where do you work?", not "Where you work?".
question_order.roman: Sawal mein helping verb subject se pehle aata hai: "Where do you work?", "Where you work?" nahi.
question_order.urdu: سوال میں مددگار فعل فاعل سے پہلے آتا ہے: ‏"Where do you work?"‏، ‏"Where you work?"‏ نہیں۔

preposition.label: wrong preposition
preposition.en: This word goes with a different preposition (e.g. "good at", "married to", "depends on").
preposition.roman: Is lafz ke saath doosra preposition aata hai (jaise "good at", "married to", "depends on").
preposition.urdu: اس لفظ کے ساتھ دوسرا حرفِ جار آتا ہے (جیسے ‏"good at"، "married to"، "depends on"‏)۔

word_choice.label: wrong or unnatural word
word_choice.en: The word is understandable, but a native speaker would choose a different one here.
word_choice.roman: Lafz samajh mein aata hai, magar yahan angrez koi aur lafz istemal karte hain.
word_choice.urdu: لفظ سمجھ میں آتا ہے، مگر یہاں انگریز کوئی اور لفظ استعمال کرتے ہیں۔

urdu_input.label: user spoke in Urdu
urdu_input.en: Here's how to say that in English. Repeat it once so it sticks.
urdu_input.roman: Ye baat English mein aise kehte hain. Ek dafa dohra lein taake yaad ho jaye.
urdu_input.urdu: یہ بات انگریزی میں ایسے کہتے ہیں۔ ایک دفعہ دہرا لیں تاکہ یاد ہو جائے۔
